Website enquiry form ka Silent Form problem: Aapki website par enquiry aayi, aur aapko pata hi nahi chala. Do din baad aapne call kiya, tab tak customer kisi aur se kaam karwa chuka tha. 😬

Isse kehte hain Silent Form: form chupchaap bhara gaya, aur koi alert nahi aaya. Customer kai jagah enquiry karta hai, aur kaam usi ko milta hai jo pehle jawab deta hai.

Fix simple hai, 3 step:
1️⃣ Form mein sirf teen fields: naam, phone, zaroorat
2️⃣ Submit ke baad screen par likhiye: hum aaj shaam tak call karenge
3️⃣ Har enquiry turant aapke WhatsApp par notification banke aaye, aur ek sheet mein bhi jaye

Test: aaj hi apna form khud bhariye aur dekhiye notification kitni der mein aaya.

Yeh video us bande ko bhejiye jo aapki website sambhalta hai. 📩

Aapki website par form bhara jaye, to aap kitni der mein jawab dete hain? Comment mein bataiye 👇
